title: Daily Brief — Morning Edition — Friday, 27 November 2026
description: Washington's tightened AI chip export rules to China bite a week in, the RBA's latest rate rise to 4.85% keeps squeezing mortgage holders, a Queensland committee wraps up its review of mining objection reforms, and the Gold Coast winds down its annual Schoolies Week. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
